name: amit

ticker_notes.SOFI: 業績及2027年指引均超預期

zh_summary: $SOFI 2026年第三季：營收14億美元（年增44%），經調整每股盈利0.18美元（年增64%），經調整EBITDA 4.698億美元（年增70%），會員1,710萬（年增35%）。2027財年指引：營收64億美元（預期60億美元），每股盈利0.90美元（預期0.82美元），EBITDA 22.4億美元，淨利12.8億美元。作者認為本季表現出色，2027年指引更強。
en_summary: $SOFI Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B (+44% YoY), adj. EPS $0.18 (+64%), adj. EBITDA $469.8M (+70%), members 17.1M (+35%). FY27 guide: revenue $6.4B vs $6B est, EPS $0.90 vs $0.82 est, EBITDA $2.24B, net income $1.28B. Author calls it an incredible quarter with an even stronger 2027 guide.
text:
$SOFI

SOFI Q3 2026 EARNINGS: 

- Revenue: $1.4B, +44% YoY
- Adj. EPS: $0.18, +64% YoY
- Adj. EBITDA: $469.8M, 70% YoY
- Members: 17.1M, +35% YoY

FY27 Guide:
- Revenue: $6.4B (Est. $6B) 
- EPS: $0.90 (Est. $0.82)
- EBITDA: $2.24B
- Net Income: $1.28B

CEO Anthony Noto: 

“We are adding more members, who are using more products, and generating more revenue per product to create the most value for our shareholders over the long run.” Our conviction in the opportunity ahead has never been greater.”

Pretty incredible quarter from SoFi and an even stronger 2027 guide.
